g.text: Each unit is one Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 V4 board with a battery and an antenna. The camera unit can also carry a GPS module and a tally

text.style: font-size: 11.88px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: LED (a small light that shows when a shot fires).

font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: battery and antenna, nothing else to wire

g.text: Screw the antenna on before you power a board: transmitting

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: without one can kill the amplifier. The firmware helps by

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: staying off the air for 2 seconds after power-on and showing

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066
font-size: 11.16px; font-family: 'Avenir Next Demi Bold'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0e0f11
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: Positive leg through a 220 to 330 ohm resistor to GPIO3, the

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: other leg to GPIO4, which the firmware holds at 0 V as ground.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: Pick GPIO3+4 under Tally LED in the setup menu.

text.style: font-size: 11.16px; font-family: 'Avenir Next Demi Bold'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0e0f11
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: The tally LED can also run from GPIO3, GPIO4 or GPIO6

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: alone, with a 220 to 330 ohm resistor to ground. Check the pin

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: labels printed on your board before soldering.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next Demi Bold'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23272b
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: end; fill: #5b6066

g.text: The GPS module talks to the board on GPIO38 and GPIO39. The firmware sets all of this up.
